suggestions.assertion: Existing content preserved: original identifiers, view keys (Contexto, Containers), styles and relationships unchanged
suggestions.reason: This run appended a new `Infrastructure Node` style rule inside the existing styles block. The original rules are unchanged so it passes, but the prompt's 'Não mude o que já existe além do necessário' could be read as forbidding unrequested additions to the styles block. The assertion should state whether additive edits to existing blocks are allowed.

Both eval-3 runs added `theme amazon-web-services-2025.07` and AWS icon tags unprompted. No assertion decides whether an unrequested theme is acceptable scope; the eval author should take a position so runs are graded consistently.

eval_feedback.overall: All six assertions pass on genuine content. This run flags more open points than the with_skill run (Portal/Worker instance counts, ALB-in-front-of-Portal) but does not ask about the ERP's placement; both are within the assertion's tolerance.
